candidates.name: Puerperal mastitis
support_spans: A 35-year-old woman presented 11 weeks postpartum with right breast erythema and pain
A 5 cm × 8 cm area of erythema and induration on the medial aspect of the right breast
a milky, nonpurulent discharge was easily expressed from both breasts
candidates.why: The patient presents with breast erythema, pain, and discharge postpartum, which are characteristic symptoms of puerperal mastitis.

candidates.name: Hyperprolactinemia
support_spans: Prolactin: 72.3 ng/mL (normal: 4.8–23.3 ng/mL)
She continued to express an excessive amount of milk despite attempts to wean
candidates.why: The patient has elevated prolactin levels and excessive milk expression, which are indicative of hyperprolactinemia.

candidates.name: Pituitary adenoma
support_spans: Slightly heterogeneous appearance of the pituitary gland without evidence of discrete mass or lesion
candidates.why: The patient's pituitary MRI shows a slightly heterogeneous appearance, which could be suggestive of a pituitary adenoma, particularly given her history of hyperprolactinemia and previous treatment with cabergoline.
